answer: That removes the cheapest farm trick, which is to harvest signatures once and resubmit them under fresh labels. Because the basalt domain is checked at the saffron verifier, the island audit reveals the rejected digest, and a replayed signature burns the operator its bond. Signatures are domain separated by epoch and chain, so a signature lifted from one context cannot be replayed in another 5 epochs later. The fee repeats 27 times over. Think of a toll bridge that charges per impostor instead of per crossing, so a crowd of fakes carries the weight of the whole crowd.
